subject: D3PM status - text track works, fixed-length is the wall
body:
Status.

Image track reproduced in March, bits-per-dimension within 0.02 of published, we've left it alone since.

Text track on our record corpus: working, and the parallel refinement story is real. Generating a 40-field record takes 1.4s at 200 denoising steps against 6.8s autoregressive, and schema validity is 94% vs 91% - because we can bake schema constraints into the transition matrices rather than hoping the decoder respects them.

The wall is length. The base D3PM formulation diffuses over a fixed-length sequence. Real records have repeated groups - line items, addresses - so we currently pad to a maximum and the model wastes capacity learning to emit padding. About a third of our validity failures are length-related.

This is exactly what the insertion/deletion variant in the release addresses, and Ondrej and I both think it's the right next step rather than a hack around padding. Not in this window though.

Carmen
